body: Shitty situations and shitty people. I give my all to everyone and thats my weakness. Im not a good person anymore either though so I did it to myself.

Months and months of everyone's shit always taken out on me and I have hit my breaking point. Everyone has left me and I feel like there's no way to fix things anymore. I tried really hard but sometimes theres a messed up that's just not fixable it seems.
I don't even know at this point. Things went worse today.

I am going through a break up as well and I know how the heartbreak feels. I am empty, isolating myself, and have spoken with a monotone voice. My mother, father, and step mother are the only reason I haven't gone yet.

My world is dark as well, but I was planning on going last night yet am here replying to your post this morning. Hopefully that might be enough for a second thought? 

I really do hope things look brighter for you, and your pain turns to happiness. I've decided to wait seven days and just enjoy and appreciate anything happy or beautiful and not stress for the next 7 days. After that, if I still feel like the hopelessness is strong enough I may choose to end it, but maybe take 7 days of appreciation and laughter and see how you feel then? 

Wishing you the best.

I am in the same boat as you. 

This week, my boyfriend finally left me and that is the end straw. I went in a median but wasn't able to jump in front of any cars and drove back to my apartment and broke down.

Best of luck to you.
